The model draft sorted each row; a full sort is a valid argpartition but a different permutation than numpy's introselect, so elementwise comparison failed. The final kernel is a line-for-line transcription of numpy 2.5.4 introselect (arg=true), validated against np.argpartition on 5256 adversarial rows in Python before the Ascend C rewrite. This is a deterministic repair, not model output; the draft is preserved under operators/argpartition/draft.
